load packages

load object

fileNam <- "/Users/immbio/Desktop/HumanHeartCarTrans2/data/Human_heart_allmerged_seurat_clean.rds"
seuratM <- readRDS(fileNam)
### diseaseCond
seuratM$diseaseCond <- "diseaseCond"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V1|V2|353921_12-12_20240515_Hu_nucseq_USZ_EMB010_V1_2", seuratM$dataset)] <- "PP"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V3", seuratM$dataset)& !(seuratM$dataset %in% "384091_03-3_20250423_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx019_V3")] <- "visit3" #Exclude rejection sample CarTrans019/3 from visit3 
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V4", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visit4"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("V5", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visit5"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("VX1|VX2|VX3|VX4|384091_03-3_20250423_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx019_V3", seuratM$dataset)] <- "visitX"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("HH", seuratM$dataset)] <- "Donorheart"
seuratM$diseaseCond[grepl("RV|LV|expLV|expRV|331571_3-5_20231012_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx001|331571_4-6_20231012_Hu_nucseq_USZ_HTx002", seuratM$dataset)] <- "Explant"


table(seuratM$diseaseCond)

#Rel Abundances of rejection_status
ordrejection_status <- c("rejection", "no_rejection")

datList <- NULL 
for(con in unique(seuratLong$rejection_status)){
  seuratSub <- subset(seuratLong, rejection_status==con)
  print(dim(seuratSub))
  dat_con <- as.data.frame(table(seuratSub$clusterName)) %>%
  mutate(percent=Freq/ncol(seuratSub)) %>% mutate(rejection_status=con)
  datList[[con]] <- dat_con
}
dat_all <- do.call("rbind", datList)

## plot abundance
ggbarplot(dat_all, x= "rejection_status", y= "percent", fill = "Var1", palette = colclusterName, legend = "right", legend.titel = "cluster", ylab = "frequency")  + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) + scale_x_discrete(limits=ordrejection_status)
